recipes.search_text: berry overnight oats creamy oats soaked in milk and topped with fresh berries, ready when you wake up. breakfast vegetarian 1 cup rolled oats 1 cup milk 1/2 cup plain yoghurt 1 tbsp honey 1 cup mixed berries

garden herb omelette a soft folded omelette with chives, parsley and a little cheese. breakfast vegetarian gluten-free 3 eggs 1 tbsp chopped chives 1 tbsp chopped parsley 2 tbsp grated cheddar 1 tsp butter pinch of salt

fluffy banana pancakes thick, tender pancakes with mashed banana stirred into the batter. breakfast vegetarian 2 ripe bananas 1 1/2 cups plain flour 1 tbsp baking powder 1 cup milk 1 egg 1 tbsp butter for the pan

lemony chickpea salad a bright, crunchy salad of chickpeas, cucumber and tomato with a lemon dressing. lunch vegan vegetarian gluten-free 1 can chickpeas, drained 1 cucumber, diced 2 tomatoes, diced 1/2 red onion, sliced 2 tbsp olive oil juice of 1 lemon handful of mint

roasted tomato soup a smooth soup made from oven-roasted tomatoes, garlic and basil. lunch vegan vegetarian gluten-free 1 kg ripe tomatoes, halved 4 garlic cloves 2 tbsp olive oil 1 onion, chopped 500 ml vegetable stock handful of basil

crispy chicken wraps quick pan-fried chicken strips in a tortilla with crunchy lettuce and yoghurt sauce. lunch 2 chicken breasts, sliced 3 large tortillas 1 tsp smoked paprika 1 tbsp oil shredded lettuce 3 tbsp plain yoghurt

mushroom risotto slow-stirred rice with browned mushrooms, white wine and parmesan. dinner vegetarian gluten-free 300 g arborio rice 250 g mushrooms, sliced 1 litre warm vegetable stock 1 onion, finely chopped 100 ml white wine 40 g parmesan, grated 2 tbsp butter

red lentil curry a warming dal of red lentils, tomato and spices served over rice. dinner vegan vegetarian gluten-free 1 1/2 cups red lentils 1 can chopped tomatoes 1 onion, diced 2 tsp curry powder 1 can coconut milk 2 cups cooked rice
lemon baked salmon oven-baked salmon fillets with lemon, dill and new potatoes. dinner gluten-free 2 salmon fillets 1 lemon, sliced fresh dill 300 g new potatoes 1 tbsp olive oil

fresh pesto pasta spaghetti tossed with basil pesto, cherry tomatoes and pine nuts. dinner vegetarian 200 g spaghetti 4 tbsp basil pesto 1 cup cherry tomatoes, halved 2 tbsp toasted pine nuts grated parmesan to serve

ginger veggie stir-fry crisp peppers, broccoli and carrots in a quick ginger and soy sauce. dinner vegan vegetarian 1 broccoli head, in florets 1 red pepper, sliced 2 carrots, thinly sliced 1 tbsp grated ginger 3 tbsp soy sauce 1 tbsp sesame oil

warm apple crumble spiced baked apples under a buttery oat crumble topping. dessert vegetarian 5 apples, peeled and sliced 1 tsp cinnamon 100 g plain flour 80 g rolled oats 100 g cold butter, cubed 80 g brown sugar
dark chocolate mousse a light, airy mousse of dark chocolate and whipped cream. dessert vegetarian gluten-free 150 g dark chocolate 300 ml double cream 2 eggs, separated 1 tbsp caster sugar

coconut rice pudding creamy stovetop rice pudding made with coconut milk and vanilla. dessert vegan vegetarian gluten-free 1 cup short-grain rice 1 can coconut milk 1 cup oat milk 3 tbsp maple syrup 1 tsp vanilla extract
